it. The merge hook (step_queue) judges an item at the absorbed rider that adds its done/ file (closing_ref) and only falls
back to the train when that rider is not absorbed; the findings list should follow the same rule. Before the change both
probe trains gave Item: none. Trains with closed fix items are ordinary (the 26 Oct trains 19 and 20); a refused merge check
blocks the train, and the documented merge-check prompt has no --item.
